2020-21 UCSC General Catalog / Courses / CMPM - Computational Media / Graduate / CMPM 290K

Computational Media
CMPM 290K Social and Emotional Approaches to Human Computer Interaction

	Focuses on enhancing social and emotional capabilities and qualities in
 interactive systems. Students read research, look at sample systems, 
and engage in evaluation, design, and prototyping exercises. A research 
project and helping to lead class discussions are also required.


		Requirements
	Enrollment is restricted to graduate students.


		Credits
	5


		Instructor
	Katherine Isbister


		Repeatable for credit
	Yes
